**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Block premature external-review entry**

When an authenticated admin submits `external_review_requested` through the existing `POST /tasks/{task_id}/transition` route, that route applies ADMIN authority to any event not listed in `ROUTED_ELSEWHERE`, so this new edge is already publicly reachable. The task then enters `EXTERNAL_PENDING`, but this slice provides no ingest activation or worker capable of emitting `external_candidate_registered`; it can only be cancelled or superseded. Refuse this event through the generic route until the dedicated external-review ingress is implemented, otherwise an API call can strand a draft in the incomplete state chain.
